description: Build quality check framework with fail-fast semantics
steps: Implement check registry and sequential runner
Configure failure behavior: abort Silver job, no partial commits
Add quality check failure exception type

description: Implement specific quality checks per RELEASE.md requirements
steps: Implement `NonNullCheck` for critical columns per entity (platform_trade_id, event_ts, market_id, etc.)
Implement `UniquenessCheck` for dedup key uniqueness within normalized batch
Implement `TimestampRangeCheck`: event_ts within expected date +/- 1 day tolerance, not in future
Implement `ReferentialCheck`: trade market_id exists in markets (optional, warn-only mode)
Define per-entity check configurations (which checks apply to which entity)

description: Wire quality checks into the processing pipeline
steps: Insert quality checks after normalization, before Iceberg write
Log quality check results with structured metrics
On failure: log details, abort processing, do not write to Iceberg
On success: include quality summary in processing metadata

description: Tests for quality checks and failure behavior
steps: Unit tests for each check with passing and failing data
Test that quality failure prevents Iceberg writes
Test quality check results are logged with metrics
Create fixtures for common quality violations (nulls, duplicates, bad timestamps)
